disclosures.text: A passing screen is not a claim that the pool is clean: the refusal count lower-bounds T-box content, and sub-threshold or CM-invisible content is invisible to both Pin 1 and Pin 2.

After Pin 2 a gated negative means 'below 10 bits on RF00230/TBDB001 and motif-free', so a CM contestant is favoured by construction (A15 Pin 7(a)): a learned model that finds a real but CM-invisible T-box in a gated host is scored as a false positive.

The 10-bit value was chosen after a v1 audit that also knew which hosts drew Stage-1 candidates. That knowledge is disclosed; the value is content-based, sitting below every v1 host hit traced to an element's own CM extent.
The motif is a backstop, not a sensitive test: an exact GGTGGNACCGCG match misses real T-boxes, and the sensitivity panel reports how often.
TBDB001 carries no GA line and its bit scale is not RF00230's; it is kept as declared redundancy, and the report carries its measured marginal.

pool.selection: ADR-0005 A15 Pins 1-2 — load_admitted_pool_rows(require_parent_nested_train=False) then parent out of fold, then the whole-window both-strand 32-mer fold screen and the RF00230/TBDB001 + motif content screen

screened_dna.alphabet_rule: upper-case, U->T; any k-mer containing a non-ACGT character is skipped, on both sides
screened_dna.rule_1: the WHOLE pre-splice window's canonical (both-strand) 32-mers against the union of the four sources
screened_dna.rule_2: same-accession overlap with a training interval, accession-version-normalised, strand-folded, closed bounds

decoy_inserts.over_approximates: every decoys_v0 insert, including the gc_background and leader_decoy pools A7 kept out of both training mixes — not a training-exposure claim (A15 Pin 1 iii)

mined_windows.interval_rule: mining_pool_v0 [locus_start, locus_end] — the WINDOW's own genomic interval, not its parent locus's (mining/pool.py::carve_window writes forward_bounds of the carved window)

stage2_population.predicate: fold_random == "train" AND NOT calib AND (nested_train true OR nested_role null) — read through stage2.train.select_rows(rung='train', admit_parentless_decoys=True)

sensitivity_panel.note: A15 Pin 2: reported, not used to set the threshold. The screen's recall on real T-box windows is a sensitivity measurement, not a gate.

v1_host_hits.definition: v1 hosts with a RF00230 hit >= 10.0 bits
